annotation.title_clean: Governance Guidelines for Implementation of AI Principles Ver. 1.1
annotation.title_en: Governance Guidelines for Implementation of AI Principles Ver. 1.1
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (METI), Expert Group on How AI Principles Should be Implemented, AI Governance Guidelines WG
annotation.summary_en: Japan's METI non-binding guidelines for companies implementing the Social Principles of Human-centric AI through agile governance. They set action targets across risk analysis, goal setting, management system design, implementation, evaluation and re-analysis, with practical examples and gap analysis appendices.
key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines are not legally binding and support voluntary corporate efforts
Action targets organised in an agile governance cycle: conditions/risk analysis, goal setting, system design, implementation, evaluation, re-analysis
Companies should perform gap analysis between AI governance goals and current state
Prepare for external explanation of AI management systems and consider disclosure as non-financial information
Plan incident response and allocate burdens among companies; living document updated over time
